slots.name: UFC 6 Parsectagon Overlay
slots.description: In-game cheats, Photo Mode, screenshots, presets, and Parsectagon Lobby for supported UFC 6 engines.
slots.note: Choose PORTHEON's games folder or a Clean Kyty engine folder.
slots.instructions: Close UFC 6 and its launcher. Choose PORTHEON's games folder (to detect games), its games\UFC6 folder, or a Clean Kyty folder containing kyty_emulator.exe. In overlay setup, keep UFC 6 selected, click Check, then Install / Update. The overlay checks engine compatibility before making changes. This is separate from the extracted game-data folder.
slots.folderPrompt: Choose PORTHEON's games folder, games\UFC6, or a Clean Kyty folder

slots.name: PORTHEON
slots.description: A free launcher for UFC 1–6 and other PC ports. It finds your games and chooses settings for your PC.
slots.note: Already have it? Use Play now after installing the game.
slots.instructions: Run the setup and follow its prompts. Open PORTHEON, choose UFC 6, and point Game files to your installed UFC 6 folder if it is not found automatically.
